research_handoff: Treat0.206 as a successful hidden-scoring baseline, not a diagnosed Class2/3 failure decomposition. Different candidates and rank errors can produce the same aggregate score.
Compare v7 against a full-background independent-spectrum library channel, then fuse its evidence with FPNet under fixed Q/L/C; validate uncertainty around the previous small reference library.

Prioritize same-formula candidate reranking/forward prediction as a measured addition, using known-permitted original weights. Restrict model use to supported adduct/domain conditions and measure compute cost.

Add popularity or structure-database signals as separate ablations after candidate recall measurement. Do not mix extra candidates, new weights, priors, and fusion then attribute the gain to one component.
Do not increase de novo breadth just because public0.206 is low. Missing pool truth, within-pool ranking, and exact chemistry normalization must first be separated on labelled holdouts.
Local NP250 remains useful for controlled comparisons but has small/common-structure and potential pretrained-exposure limits. Maintain broader structure-grouped and independent-spectrum diagnostics.
